_about: The one list of every add-on's tier. Used by the installer (scripts/install.sh), the README and the Settings page. Edit here only. Tiers: core = finished, on by default; beta = shipped, off until you switch it on; experimental = only with "Everything", off until you switch it on; separate = its own download.

dsh-activity.label: Activity
dsh-activity.reason: Finished and tested: a small indicator of what the assistant is doing.

dsh-agent-swarm.label: Agent swarm
dsh-agent-swarm.reason: Many helpers at once can spend a lot quickly and has had little real-world testing.

dsh-artifacts.label: Artifacts
dsh-artifacts.reason: Works, but its privacy rules for private conversations were fixed only recently.

dsh-automations.label: Alerts
dsh-automations.reason: Finished and tested: shows how scheduled tasks ended.

dsh-balance.label: Balance
dsh-balance.reason: Finished and tested: shows your DeepSeek balance.

dsh-bench.label: Devices
dsh-bench.reason: Controls boards, phones and routers; only tested with stand-ins, not with real devices.

dsh-benchmark.label: Benchmark
dsh-benchmark.reason: Finished and tested: compares models on your own questions.

dsh-budget.label: Budget
dsh-budget.reason: Finished and tested: limits that stop a runaway task.

dsh-code-map.label: Code map
dsh-code-map.reason: Finished and tested: a compact map of your project.

dsh-code-power.label: Code power
dsh-code-power.reason: Finished and tested: code review and fix skills.

dsh-color-schemes.label: Colours
dsh-color-schemes.reason: Finished and tested: colour schemes for the whole app.

dsh-content.label: Content
dsh-content.reason: Works, but is new and has had little use by people other than its maker.

dsh-context-saver.label: Context saver
dsh-context-saver.reason: Needs separate Python tools and changes what the assistant sees; not yet proven.

dsh-cowork-shell.label: Cowork sidebar
dsh-cowork-shell.reason: Finished and tested: the Chat, Cowork and Code tabs.

dsh-creator-plus.label: Creator Plus
dsh-creator-plus.reason: Builds and changes add-ons itself, so a mistake can break other add-ons.

dsh-data.label: Data
dsh-data.reason: Works, but is new and has had little use by people other than its maker.

dsh-deep-research.label: Deep research
dsh-deep-research.reason: Finished and tested: parallel research with checked sources.

dsh-diagram.label: Diagrams
dsh-diagram.reason: Finished and tested: drawn diagrams from a description.

dsh-engines.label: Engines
dsh-engines.reason: Has never been run with a real outside engine.

dsh-evolve.label: Self-improvement
dsh-evolve.reason: Finished and tested; every change needs your approval.

dsh-finance.label: Finance
dsh-finance.reason: Works, but gives market views, so it starts off and shows a warning first.

dsh-learn.label: Learning
dsh-learn.reason: Finished and tested: a tutor that makes you do the thinking.

dsh-library.label: Library
dsh-library.reason: Finished and tested: search your own documents.

dsh-mac.label: Mac tools
dsh-mac.reason: Finished and tested: Spotlight and Shortcuts, only in folders you allow.

dsh-media-tools.label: Media tools

dsh-memory.label: Memory
dsh-memory.reason: Finished and tested: lasting facts about you.

dsh-mission.label: Mission
dsh-mission.reason: Finished and tested: a goal worked on by several models.

dsh-model-arena.label: Model arena
dsh-model-arena.reason: Finished and tested: a blind comparison of models.

dsh-model-router.label: Model router

dsh-model-tiers.label: Model Tiers
dsh-model-tiers.reason: Finished and tested: the model button and tiers.

dsh-modes.label: Modes
dsh-modes.reason: Finished and tested: Chat, Cowork and Code modes.

dsh-notify.label: Notify
dsh-notify.reason: Runs a command you write when a turn ends; being merged into Alerts.

dsh-pdf.label: PDF reader
dsh-pdf.reason: Finished and tested: reads PDFs with the Mac's own tools.

dsh-privacy.label: Privacy

dsh-recon.label: Recon
dsh-recon.reason: Reaches Tor and Usenet, so it is a separate download with its own warning.

dsh-research.label: Research
dsh-research.reason: Works, but is new and has had little use by people other than its maker.

dsh-role-prompts.label: Role prompts
dsh-role-prompts.reason: Finished and tested: your own instruction sections.

dsh-route-health.label: Route health
dsh-route-health.reason: Moves a conversation to another model by itself when one is down; not proven.

dsh-sampling-presets.label: Sampling
dsh-sampling-presets.reason: Finished and tested: temperature and length presets.

dsh-scout.label: Scout
dsh-scout.reason: Searches for work on outside sites; little tested.

dsh-search.label: Search
dsh-search.reason: Finished and tested: find conversations with Cmd-K.

dsh-settings-plus.label: Settings Plus
dsh-settings-plus.reason: Finished and tested: groups and searches the Settings window.

dsh-shared-settings.label: Shared settings
dsh-shared-settings.reason: Tried on one Mac only; a wrong merge could overwrite settings on another Mac.

dsh-skill-architect.label: Learned skills
dsh-skill-architect.reason: Finished and tested; nothing is installed without your approval.

dsh-split-plus.label: Split Plus
dsh-split-plus.reason: Several conversations in one window; not yet tried in the desktop app.

dsh-sync.label: Sync
dsh-sync.reason: Finished and tested: conversations between Macs through your own git repository.

dsh-tuning.label: Tuner Plus
dsh-tuning.reason: Collects training rows from your work; new and not yet proven.

dsh-usage-ledger.label: Usage
dsh-usage-ledger.reason: Finished and tested: counts requests and tokens.

dataFolders.what: your projects list, presets and versions
the conversations you deleted in the Cowork sidebar (kept 30 days): removing this folder deletes them for good; the app cannot show them without Plus
the list of files your conversations made, their versions and their trash
the index of your documents (the documents themselves are not touched)
your study records (no text of yours)
the alerts list and run notes
your daily request and token counts
Tuner Plus training rows and data sets
Creator Plus runs, backups and prepared changes
Split Plus layouts and the send room
scratch work folders of conversations without a project
the local copy of your conversation repository (the remote one is untouched)
which iCloud folder is shared, and backups of this Mac's settings

dataNeverRemoved.what: your conversations; the app owns them
the learned skills you approved, and proposals still waiting for your yes. They are your work, so Plus never removes them
add-ons you or Creator Plus made. The app still lists them without Plus, so Plus never removes them
your skills, including learned ones you approved
the app's settings, models and keys
dated copies of your setup from every install and uninstall; they let you undo
